System rules & unresolved details

The interface follows Types → Objects → Connections → Assemblies. The geometry comes from the pinned WikiHouse Skylark 150 release. Objects retain their source IDs and shapes; placement uses rigid transforms.

Skylark uses load-bearing wall blocks and floor/roof beam blocks. The previous generic post-and-beam frame is not its structural arrangement. E-S is an end-floor beam, not a substitute timber lintel.

The assembly is an open row of 1–8 chassis slices for checking interfaces, not a complete building. Floor and roof seam ties are shown using source sockets and sampled fit checks. End-wall closure is unresolved; automatic openings are on hold pending precise instructions. Foundations, end-wall closure, lateral bracing and project engineering are not included. Connection checks establish sampled geometric fit, not strength, full collision clearance or installation access.

One R-S source Brep is open; it is retained and flagged. W-O-S-1 and E-S remain available for inspection but are not placed in the chassis slice. No source parts have been silently resized or repaired.
